examples.description: Revoke a fullmakt and retire its agent principal

description: Revoke a fullmakt — withdraw an agent's delegated authority for a Norwegian company and retire the agent principal. Given ONLY the agent_principal_id (system_user_id and org_number resolve server-side), Apier revokes the bound delegation and flips the principal to terminal `revoked`, never resurrected. Agent principals cannot yet be created through the public API; a new one comes from the account owner. LOCAL revocation is immediate in Apier's own check (recorded state, not an Altinn confirmation). Idempotent: revoking an already-revoked principal is a 200 no-op. `warnings[]` carries NAMED outcome tokens (principal_revoke_failed, delegation_not_found, upstream_revoke_unconfirmed): read the token. Failure modes: FULLMAKT_PRINCIPAL_NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_FAILED; a credential without `read:altinn` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). No sandbox mirror; returns SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE under a sandbox bearer. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/fullmakt
description_nb: Tilbakekall en fullmakt og avvikle agentprincipalen. Gitt KUN agent_principal_id tilbakekaller Apier delegeringen og setter principalen til terminal `revoked`, som aldri gjenopprettes; agentprincipaler kan ennå ikke opprettes gjennom det offentlige grensesnittet, så be kontoeieren om en ny for å handle igjen. LOKAL tilbakekalling gjelder straks i Apiers egen kontroll (registrert tilstand, ikke en bekreftelse fra Altinn); idempotent (200 uten endring). `warnings[]` bærer navngitte utfallstoken. Krever read:altinn. Ingen sandkassespeil; under en sandkassenøkkel returneres SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.

agent_principal_id.description: The agent principal (UUID) whose delegation to revoke — one of YOUR OWN; an unknown or foreign id returns FULLMAKT_PRINCIPAL_NOT_FOUND.

reason.description: Optional operator-facing reason, recorded on the audit row only. Send content or omit — an empty string is rejected.

name: revoke_fullmakt

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The revocation outcome: `revoked: true`, the `agent_principal` snapshot, and `warnings[]` (empty on the clean path; NAMED tokens otherwise).

title: Revoke a fullmakt (retire a delegation + its principal)
